description: Watch who’s in your sphere , do not allow them to dim your light #selflove
transcript: If you do not like yourself, and if you deal with interpersonal things that you cannot manage, you will never like me. Or so many people that love the idea of the light of being around someone that's confident, someone who loves themselves, they get around you and see that that light that shines is real. And they try to dim it. They are uncomfortable by your light. It's so important to be mindful of who you allow in your sphere. Most people do not like who they are.
